```{r setup, include=FALSE} knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE) library(kableExtra) library(tidyverse) library(sf) library(mapview) mainColor <- "#90D5FF" mainColorDark <- "#8A817C" contrast1 <- "#a40707" contrast2 <- "#6600FF" typefaceDark <- "#0047AB" cortland <- read_sf(dsn = "gis/shapefiles/shp-zoning-20251008/shp-zoning-20251008.shp") ``` ## AG-1 Agriculture Residential District ::: {.content-hidden when-format="pdf"} ```{r Viz AG-1} #| warning: false #| message: false #| echo: false ag1 <- cortland %>% filter(zoning == "ag") %>% mutate(zoning = "AG-1") %>% rename("Zoning" = "zoning") mapview::mapview( ag1, zcol = "Zoning", map.types = c("CartoDB.Positron", "Esri.WorldImagery"), col.regions = c( "#A3FF73" ), alpha.regions = c(0.50), lwd = 1.5, layer.name = "Zoning" ) ``` ::: ### Intent This District is intended for general agricultural and residential purposes within one-half (1/2) mile of the corporate limits of the Village of Cortland. ### Permitted Principal Uses and Structures The following shall be permitted as uses by right:
  1. Single family dwellings, ranch and farm residences;
  2. General farming and ranching activities, excluding any expansion of existing or development of livestock confinement facilities/operations.
  3. Public facilities and utility distribution systems;
  4. One additional single family, ranch and farm residence for the purpose of housing relatives or agricultural workers; and
  5. Churches, places of worship and cemeteries.
### Permitted Accessory Uses and Structures The following accessory uses and structures shall be permitted:
  1. Accessory uses and structures normally appurtenant to the permitted uses and structures and to uses and structures permitted as special uses;
  2. Home occupations in accordance with Article 8.2; and
  3. Roadside stands for the sale of agricultural produce grown on the agricultural farm or operation.
### Permitted Special Uses A building or premise may be used for the following purpose in the “AG-1” Agricultural District if a special permit for such use has been obtained in accordance with Article 6 of these regulations.
  1. Sewage disposal and water systems, including agricultural irrigation wells;
  2. Public and private uses including parks, playgrounds, golf courses, campgrounds, recreation use, riding stables and dude ranches;
  3. Flood, erosion and sediment control projects
  4. Broadcast towers and stations, including Amateur Radio or land mobile towers of more than 100 feet when in conformance with the following:
    1. Towers, including wind generation towers, shall be located a minimum distance of twice the height of the tower from adjacent dwellings or structures other than those associated with the tower facility.
    2. Towers shall be a minimum distance from any street, county road or federal highway of equal to or greater than the height of the tower measured from the right-of-way line.
    3. Towers shall have direct frontage on, or direct access to, an improved street, country or township road (not including dirt or minimum maintenance roads).
    4. Towers must comply with the regulations of the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA).
  5. Bed and breakfast establishments;
  6. Salvage or junk yard in accordance with Section 6.3;
  7. Mineral extraction, which shall include the following: oil wells, sand and gravel extraction and quarries;
  8. Expansion of existing or development of new livestock confinement facility or operation; Other Conditions include:
    1. Tract of land must be located at least one-eighth (1/8) mile from any residence or commercial or industrial facility, or church or school, or any other facility operated and/or utilized by the general public other than the residence of the owner and/or operator of the subject facility; and
    2. Total limit of livestock at one facility located within the AG-1 Agricultural District shall not exceed a combination of 50 head.
  9. Commercial, manufacturing and/or industrial operations; and
  10. Similar uses to those listed above that are determined by the Village Board after review and recommendaiton of approval by the Planning Commission.
### Prohibited Uses and Structures All other uses and structures which are not specially permitted or not permissible as special uses shall be prohibited from the AG-1 Agricultural District. ### Special Regulation Provisions must be made for disposal of wastes in accordance with local and state regulations. ### Minimum Lot Requirements
  1. The minimum lot area for AGR uses shall be 10 acres.[^05_zoning_districts-1]
    2. [^05_zoning_districts-1]: Lots with an existing rural dwelling may have a minimum area of 3 acres.
### Minimum Yard Requirements No structure shall be placed within two hundred (200) feet of high water mark of waterways in designated district. ### Maximum Height No limitation. ## AG-2 Agriculture District ::: {.content-hidden when-format="pdf"} ```{r Viz AG-2} #| warning: false #| message: false #| echo: false ag2 <- cortland %>% filter(zoning == "ag2") %>% mutate(zoning = "AG-2") %>% rename("Zoning" = "zoning") mapview::mapview( ag2, zcol = "Zoning", map.types = c("CartoDB.Positron", "Esri.WorldImagery"), col.regions = c( "#38A800" ), alpha.regions = c(0.50), lwd = 1.5, layer.name = "Zoning" ) ``` ::: ### Intent This district is intended for general agricultural starting one-half (1/2) mile from the corporate limits and extending to the one (1) mile planning jurisdiction line of the Village of Cortland. ### Permitted Principal Uses and Structures The following shall be permitted as uses by right:
  1. Single family dwellings, ranch and farm residences;
  2. General farming and ranching activities, excluding any expansion of existing or development of livestock confinement facilities/operations.
  3. Public facilities and utility distribution systems;
  4. One additional single family, ranch and farm residence for the purpose of housing relatives or agricultural workers; and
  5. Churches, places of worship and cemeteries.
### Permitted Accessory Uses and Structures The following accessory uses and structures shall be permitted:
  1. Accessory uses and structures normally appurtenant to the permitted uses and structures and to uses and structures permitted as special uses;
  2. Home occupations in accordance with Article 8.2; and
  3. Roadside stands for the sale of agricultural produce grown on the agricultural farm or operation.
### Permitted Special Uses A building or premises may be used for the following purposes in the "AG-2" Agricultural District if a special permit for such use has been obtained in accordance with Article 6 of these regulations.
  1. Sewage disposal and water systems, including agricultural irrigation wells;
  2. Public and private uses including parks, playgrounds, golf courses, campgrounds, recreation uses, riding stables and dude ranches;
  3. Flood, erosion and sediment control projects;
  4. Broadcast towers and stations, including Amateur Radio or land mobile towers of more than 100 feet when in conformance with the following:
    1. Towers, including wind generation towers, shall be located a minimum distance of twice the height of the tower from adjacent dwellings or structures other than those associated with the tower facility.
    2. Towers shall be a minimum distance from any street, county road or federal highway of equal to or greater than the height of the tower measured from the right-of-way line.
    3. Towers shall have direct frontage on, or direct access to, an improved street, country or township road (not including dirt or minimum maintenance roads).
    4. Towers must comply with the regulations of the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA).
  5. Bed and breakfast establishments;
  6. Salvage or junk yard in accordance with Section 6.3;
  7. Mineral extraction, which shall include the following: oil wells, sand and gravel extraction and quarries;
  8. Expansion of existing or development of new livestock confinement facility or operation; Other Conditions include:
    1. Tract of land must be located at least one-eighth (1/8) mile from any residence or commercial or industrial facility, or church or school, or any other facility operated and/or utilized by the general public other than the residence of the owner and/or operator of the subject facility; and
    2. Total limit of livestock at one facility located within the AG-2 Agricultural District shall not exceed a combination of 250 head.
  9. Commercial, manufacturing and/or industrial operations; and
  10. Similar uses to those listed above that are determined by the Village Board after review and recommendation of approval by the Planning Commission.
### Prohibited Uses and Structures All other uses and structures which are not specially permitted or not permissible as special uses shall be prohibited form the AGR Agricultural Residential District. ### Special Regulation Provisions must be made for disposal of wastes in accordance with local and state regulations. ### Minimum Lot Requirements
  1. The minimum lot area for AGR uses shall be 20 acres.[^05_zoning_districts-2]
    2. [^05_zoning_districts-2]: Lots with an existing rural dwelling may have a minimum area of 3 acres.
### Minimum Yard Requirements No structure shall be placed within two hundred (200) feet of high water mark of waterways in designated district. ### Maximum Height No limitation. ## R-1 Residential Single Family District ::: {.content-hidden when-format="pdf"} ```{r Viz R-1} #| warning: false #| message: false #| echo: false r1map <- cortland %>% filter(zoning == "r1") %>% mutate(zoning = "R-1") %>% rename("Zoning" = "zoning") mapview::mapview( r1map, zcol = "Zoning", map.types = c("CartoDB.Positron", "Esri.WorldImagery"), col.regions = c( "#FF7F7F" ), alpha.regions = c(0.50), lwd = 1.5, layer.name = "Zoning" ) ``` ::: ### Intent This district is intended to provide for residential uses consisting primarily of single family dwelling units and accessory structures by also including the permitted uses set forth in Section 5.32 below. ### Permitted Principal Uses and Structures The following shall be permitted as uses by right:
  1. Single family dwellings;
  2. Manufactured homes which comply with the provisions of Article 8.3;
  3. Public and parochial schools;
  4. Public parks, buildings and grounds;
  5. Child care homes;
  6. Public uses: including but not limited to public parks, playgrounds, recreational uses, fire stations, public utilities and utility distribution systems; and
  7. Places of worship such as churches and synagogues.
### Permitted Accessory Uses and Structures The following accessory uses and structures shall be permitted:
  1. Home occupations in accordance with Article 8.2.
  2. Accessory uses and structures normally appurtenant to permitted uses and structures.
### Permitted Special Uses A building or premises may be used for the following purpose in the R-1 Residential District if a special permit for such use has been obtained in accordance with Article 6 of these regulations.
  1. Medical clinics;
  2. Mortuaries;
  3. Child care center;
  4. Museum and art galleries;
  5. Nursing homes;
  6. Public and private golf courses;
  7. Retirement homes;
  8. Bed and breakfast homes;
  9. Two family dwellings;
  10. Townhouses; and
  11. Multifamily dwellings.
### Prohibited Uses and Structures All other uses and structures which are not specifically permitted or not permissible as special uses shall be prohibited from the R-1 Residential District. ### Height and Area Regulations The maximum height and minimum area regulations shall be as follows:
  1. General Requirements ```{r R-1 heights, echo = FALSE} r1 <- data.frame("Type" = c("Single Family Dwelling", "Two Family Dwelling", "Other Permitted Uses"), "Lot Area (Sq. Ft.)" = c("14,000", "7,000 per family", "14,000"), "Required Front Yard" = c("25'", "25'", "25'"), "Required Side Yard" = c("7'", "7'", "7'"), "Required Rear Yard" = c("30'", "30'", "30'"), "Height" = c("35'", "35'", "35'") ) colnames(r1) <- c("Type", "Lot Area (Sq. Ft.)", "Required Front Yard", "Required Side Yard", "Required Rear Yard", "Height") knitr::kable(r1, align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c"), longtable = TRUE) %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), position = "left", full_width = F, fixed_thead = T, latex_options = c("striped", "HOLD_position", "repeat_header")) %>% row_spec(row = 0, color = "white", background = "gray") %>% column_spec(1:6, width = "5em") ```
  2. Buildings on corner lots shall provide front yard setbacks of twenty-five (25) feet on one street side and fifteen (15) feet on the other front yard and designate remaining yards as one rear and one side yard;
  3. Building and structures shall not exceed two and one half (2 1/2) stories in height;
  4. The side yard setback between individual units of two-family dwellings may be reduced to zero, if a one-hour fire rated constructed common wall between units starting at the basement level and continuing through the roof line is maintained.
    5. ### Parking Regulations Parking within the R-1 Residential Ordinance District shall be in conformance with the provisions of Article 7 of this ordinance.
## R-2 Residential Single and Multifamily District ::: {.content-hidden when-format="pdf"} ```{r Viz R-2} #| warning: false #| message: false #| echo: false r2map <- cortland %>% filter(zoning == "r2") %>% mutate(zoning = "R-2") %>% rename("Zoning" = "zoning") mapview::mapview( r2map, zcol = "Zoning", map.types = c("CartoDB.Positron", "Esri.WorldImagery"), col.regions = c( "#FF0000" ), alpha.regions = c(0.50), lwd = 1.5, layer.name = "Zoning" ) ``` ::: ### Intent It is the intent of this district to provide for single and multifamily residential uses and development of residential dwellings at higher densities. R-2 Residential Districts should be located in a manner to buffer lower density R-1 Residential Districts from the more intensive commercial and industrial districts and in locations suited for multifamily uses. ### Permitted Principal Uses and Structures The following shall be permitted as uses by right:
  1. Single family dwellings;
  2. Manufactured homes which comply with the provisions of Article 8.3;
  3. Two-family dwellings;
  4. Child care homes;
  5. Community buildings;
  6. Public uses; including but not limited to public parks, playgrounds, recreational uses, fire stations, public elementary and high schools, public utilities and utility distribution systems; and
  7. Places of worship such as churches and synagogues.
### Permitted Accessory Uses and Structures The following accessory uses and structures shall be permitted:
  1. Home occupations in accordance with Article 8.2; and
  2. Accessory uses and structures normally appurtenant to the permitted uses and structures.
### Permitted Special Uses A building or premises may be used for the following purposes in the R-2 Residential District if a special permit for such use has been obtained in accordance with Article 6 of these regulations:
  1. Multifamily dwellings;
  2. Child care center;
  3. Bed and breakfast homes;
  4. Communication and utility buildings and uses;
  5. Medical clinics;
  6. Funeral homes and mortuaries;
  7. Clubs, fraternities, lodges, and meeting places of a non-commercial natures; and
  8. Public and/or private golf courses.
### Prohibited Uses and Structures All other uses and structures which are not specifically permitted or not permissible as special uses shall be prohibited. ### Height and Area Regulations The maximum height and minimum area regulations shall be as follows:
  1. General Requirements ```{r R-2 heights, echo = FALSE} r2 <- data.frame("Type" = c("Single Family Dwelling", "Two Family Dwelling", "Multifamily Dwelling", "Other Permitted Uses"), "Lot Area (Sq. Ft.)" = c("14,000", "7,000 per family", "2,200 per family", "14,000"), "Lot Width" = c("100'", "50' per family", "100'", "100'"), "Required Front Yard" = c("25'", "25'", "25'", "25'"), "Required Side Yard" = c("5' or 15' on corner lot", "5' or 15' on corner lot", "5' or 15' on corner lot", "5'"), "Required Rear Yard" = c("15'", "15'", "15'", "15'"), "Height" = c("35'", "35'", "45'", "35'") ) colnames(r2) <- c("Type", "Lot Area (Sq. Ft.)", "Lot Width", "Required Front Yard", "Required Side Yard", "Required Rear Yard", "Height") knitr::kable(r2, align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c"), longtable = TRUE) %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), position = "left", full_width = F, fixed_thead = T, latex_options = c("striped", "HOLD_position", "repeat_header")) %>% row_spec(row = 0, color = "white", background = "gray") %>% column_spec(1:6, width = "5em") ```
  2. Buildings on corner lots shall provide a second frontage on the street side of not less than fifteen (15) feet, provided that the buildable width need not be reduced to less than twenty-eight (28) feet, yards remaining shall be designated side yards each with a minimum depth of five (5) feet; Buildings on corner lots with a width of over one hundred (100) feet shall provide a second frontage on the street side of not less than fifteen (15) feet, yards remaining shall be designated side yards with a minimum depth of five (5) feet;
  3. Building and structures shall not exceed three (3) stories in height.
    4. ### Parking Regulations Parking within the R-2 Residential District shall be in conformance with the provisions of Article 7 of these regulations. ## R-3 Residential Mobile Home/Single and Multifamily District ::: {.content-hidden when-format="pdf"} ```{r Viz R-3} #| warning: false #| message: false #| echo: false r3map <- cortland %>% filter(zoning == "r3") %>% mutate(zoning = "R-3") %>% rename("Zoning" = "zoning") mapview::mapview( r3map, zcol = "Zoning", map.types = c("CartoDB.Positron", "Esri.WorldImagery"), col.regions = c( "#A80000" ), alpha.regions = c(0.50), lwd = 1.5, layer.name = "Zoning" ) ``` ::: ### Intent It is the intent of this district to provide for single and multifamily residential uses and development of residential dwellings including mobile homes and mobile home parks. Mobile home parks are considered as a residential use and should be located in areas where services and amenities are available, such as those found in conventional residential uses. ### Permitted Principal Uses and Structures The following shall be permitted as uses by right:
    1. Single family dwellings
    2. Mobile Home Parks in accordance with the provisions of Article 8.7;
    3. Manufactured homes which comply with the provisions of Article 8.3;
    4. Two-family dwellings;
    5. Multifamily dwellings;
    6. Child care homes;
    7. Community buildings;
    8. Public uses: including but not limited to public parks, playgrounds, recreational uses, fire stations, public elementary and high schools, public utilities and utility distribution systems; and
    9. Places of worship such as churches and synagogues.
    ### Permitted Accessory Uses and Structures The following accessory uses and structures shall be permitted:
    1. Home occupations in accordance with Article 8.2; and
    2. Accessory uses and structures normally appurtenant to the permitted uses and structures.
    ### Permitted Special Uses A building or premises may be used for the following purposes in the R-3 Residential District if a special permit for such use has been obtained in accordance with Article 6 of these regulations:
    1. Child care center;
    2. Bed and breakfast homes;
    3. Communication and utility buildings and uses;
    4. Medical clinics;
    5. Funeral homes and mortuaries;
    6. Clubs, fraternities, lodges, and meeting places of a non-commercial nature;
    7. Public and/or private golf courses; and
    8. Mobile homes on permanent foundations which comply with the provisions of Section 8.3.
    ### Prohibited Uses and Structures All other uses and structures which are not specifically permitted or not permissible as special uses shall be prohibited from the R-3 Residential District. ### Height and Area Regulations The maximum height and minimum area regulations shall be as follows:
    1. General Requirements ```{r R-3 heights, echo = FALSE} r3 <- data.frame("Type" = c("Single Family Dwelling", "Two Family Dwelling", "Multifamily Dwelling", "Other Permitted Uses"), "Lot Area (Sq. Ft.)" = c("14,000", "7,000 per family", "2,200 per family", "14,000"), "Lot Width" = c("100'", "50' per family", "100'", "100'"), "Required Front Yard" = c("25'", "25'", "25'", "25'"), "Required Side Yard" = c("5' or 15' on corner lot", "5' or 15' on corner lot", "5' or 15' on corner lot", "5'"), "Required Rear Yard" = c("15'", "15'", "15'", "15'"), "Height" = c("35'", "35'", "45'", "35'") ) colnames(r3) <- c("Type", "Lot Area (Sq. Ft.)", "Lot Width", "Required Front Yard", "Required Side Yard", "Required Rear Yard", "Height") knitr::kable(r3, align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c"), longtable = TRUE) %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), position = "left", full_width = F, fixed_thead = T, latex_options = c("striped", "HOLD_position", "repeat_header")) %>% row_spec(row = 0, color = "white", background = "gray") %>% column_spec(1:6, width = "5em") ```
    2. Buildings on corner lots shall provide a second frontage on the street side of not less than fifteen (15) feet, provided that the buildable width need not be reduced to less than twenty-eight (28) feet, yards remaining shall be designated side yards each with a minimum depth of five (5) feet;
    3. Building and structures shall not exceed three (3) stories in height.
    ### Parking Regulations Parking within the R-3 Residential District shall be in conformance with the provisions of Article 7 of these regulations. ## C-1 General Commercial District ::: {.content-hidden when-format="pdf"} ```{r Viz C-1} #| warning: false #| message: false #| echo: false c1map <- cortland %>% filter(zoning == "c1") %>% mutate(zoning = "C-1") %>% rename("Zoning" = "zoning") mapview::mapview( c1map, zcol = "Zoning", map.types = c("CartoDB.Positron", "Esri.WorldImagery"), col.regions = c( "#73FFDF" ), alpha.regions = c(0.50), lwd = 1.5, layer.name = "Zoning" ) ``` ::: ### Intent This district is designed to provide for a wide range of retail, office, amusement and service uses normally found in a Central Business District. Highest density and intensity of use are permitted in this district. ### Permitted Principal Uses and Structures The following shall be permitted as uses by right:
    1. Automobile sales and services;
    2. Automotive wash facilities;
    3. Bakery;
    4. Banks, savings and loan associations, credit unions and finance companies;
    5. Barbershops, beauty parlors and shoeshine shops;
    6. Business offices;
    7. Child care homes and centers;
    8. Commercial recreation facilities (bowling alleys, miniature golf courses and similar uses);
    9. Convenience store or filling station;
    10. Detached banking facilities (ATM);
    11. Dry cleaning or laundry establishments;
    12. Food service, retaurants and taverns;
    13. Food storage lockers;
    14. Funeral homes and mortuaries;
    15. Garden centers;
    16. Motels and hotels;
    17. Museums and art galleries;
    18. Office buildings;
    19. Parking lots and other off-street parking facilities;
    20. Personal and professional services;
    21. Photography studios;
    22. Private schools, including but not limited to business or commercial schools, and dance or music academies;
    23. Public and private charitable institutions;
    24. Public parks, buildings and grounds;
    25. Public uses of an administrative, public service or cultural type including city, county, state or federal administrative centers and courts, libraries, police and fire stations and other public buildings, structures, and facilities;
    26. Retail store or business;
    27. Public utility facilities;
    28. Sales and showrooms, including service facilities and rental of equipment, provided all displays and merchandise are within the enclosure walls of the buildings;
    29. Service stations; and
    30. Stores or shops for the sale of goods at retail and/or wholesale.
    ### Permitted Accessory Uses and Structures The following accessory uses and structures shall be permitted:
    1. Accessory uses and structures normally appurtenant to permitted uses and structures and to uses and structures permitted as special uses.
    ### Permitted Special Uses A building or premises may be used for the following purposes in the C-1 Commercial Business District if a special permit for such use has been obtained in accordance with Article 6 of these regulations.
    1. Multifamily dwellings;
    2. Bed and breakfast guest home;
    3. Recycling center; and
    4. Apartments on floors other than ground floors.
    5. Conversion of an existing building only into a single family dwelling with a minimum of twenty five percent (25\%)square footage above grade dedicatd to a permitted use allowed pursuant ot Cortland Zoning Regulation 5.6.2. Store-front signage for the permitted use shall be prominently displayed. In the event of damage or destruction to the building caused by a natural disaster or fire, the permitholder shall be allowed to reconstruct the building consistent with the terms of the special use permit. Special use permits granted pursuant to this section 5.6.4 (5) shall not be transferrable to future property owners unless the Village Board specifically allows for such transferability upon the recommendation of the Planning Comission.
    ### Prohibited Uses and Structures All other uses and structures which are not specifically permitted or not permissible as special uses shall be prohibited from the C-1 Commercial Business District. ### Screening Requirements
    1. Where a site adjoins or is located across an alley from the Residential District, a solid wall or fence or compact evergreeen hedge six (6) feet in height may be required on the property line common to such districts, except in a required front yard.
    2. Open storage of materials attendant to a permitted use or special permit use shall be permitted only within an area surrounded or screened by a solid wall or fence.
    ### Prohibited Uses
    1. No use shall be permitted and no process, equipment or materials shall be used which are found by the Village to be objectionable to persons living or working in the vicinity by reasons of odor, fumes, dust, smoke, cinders, dirt, refuse, noise, vibrations, illumination, glare, or unsightliness or to involve any hazard of fire or explosion.
    ### Height and Area Regulations The maximum height and minimum area regulations shall be as follows:
    1. General Requirements ```{r C-1 heights, echo = FALSE} c1 <- data.frame("Type" = c("Permitted Uses", "Multifamily Dwelling"), "Lot Area (Sq. Ft.)" = c("3,750", "2,200 per family"), "Lot Width" = c("25'", "50'"), "Required Front Yard" = c("0'", "25'"), "Required Side Yard" = c("0' or 10' when abutting a residential district", "5' or 7.5' on corner lots"), "Required Rear Yard" = c("15'", "15'"), "Height" = c("45'", "45'") ) colnames(c1) <- c("Type", "Lot Area (Sq. Ft.)", "Lot Width", "Required Front Yard", "Required Side Yard", "Required Rear Yard", "Height") knitr::kable(c1, align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c"), longtable = TRUE) %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), position = "left", full_width = F, fixed_thead = T, latex_options = c("striped", "HOLD_position", "repeat_header")) %>% row_spec(row = 0, color = "white", background = "gray") %>% column_spec(1:6, width = "5em") ```
    ### Parking Regulations Off-street parking and loading requirements contained in Article 7 do not apply to the C-1 General Commercial District. ## C-2 Highway Commercial District ::: {.content-hidden when-format="pdf"} ```{r Viz C-2} #| warning: false #| message: false #| echo: false c2map <- cortland %>% filter(zoning == "c2") %>% mutate(zoning = "C-2") %>% rename("Zoning" = "zoning") mapview::mapview( c2map, zcol = "Zoning", map.types = c("CartoDB.Positron", "Esri.WorldImagery"), col.regions = c( "#005CE6" ), alpha.regions = c(0.50), lwd = 1.5, layer.name = "Zoning" ) ``` ::: ### Intent The C-2 Highway Commercial District is intended for the purpose of servicing highway travelers and providing limited commercial services. Off-street parking is required to reduce possible adverse effects on adjacent properties. ### Permitted Principal Uses and Structures The following shall be permitted as uses by right:
    1. Automobile sales;
    2. Automobile wash facilities;
    3. Business offices, sales, and services;
    4. Churches and other religious institutions;
    5. Commercial condo;
    6. Construction sales and services;
    7. Commercial operations and businesses;
    8. Commercial recreational facilities (bowling alleys, miniature golf courses and similar uses);
    9. Convenience store or filling station;
    10. Detached banking facilities (ATM)
    11. Farm implement sales and services;
    12. Food service, restaurants, taverns and cafes;
    13. Garden centers and nurseries;
    14. Irrigation equipment sales and services;
    15. Medical clinics;
    16. Mobile home sales;
    17. Motels, including accessory service uses, such as swimming pools, liquor stores and restaurants;
    18. Service stations;
    19. Stores or shops for sale of goods at retail.
    ### Permitted Accessory Uses and Accessory Structures The following accessory uses and accessory structures shall be permitted:
    1. Accessory uses and accessory structures normally appurtenant to the permitted uses and special uses shall adhere to Article 8.1 of these regulations. Accessory structures must adhere to 5.7.7 Setback Requirements.
    2. Accessory buildings are not permitted in the C-2 Highway Commercial District.
    ### Permitted Special Uses A building or premises may be used for the following purposes in the C-2 Highway Commercial District if a special use permit for such use has been obtained in accordance with Article 6 of these regulations.
    1. Private clubs and lodges;
    2. Facilities for the commercial storage or sale of fertilizer, seed, or toxic or flammable agriculture chemicals.
    3. Radio studios, transmitters, and antenna;
    4. Recycling centers;
    5. Residential units located on the upper levels of commercial buildings that are no less than 2-bedroom units and no less than 1,100 square feet in total area;
    6. Commercial storage and wholesale/retail sale of fireworks; and
    7. Light manufacturing operations, provided that such use is not noxious by reason of vibration or noise beyond the confines of the building, or by the emission of particulates, fumes, gas, odor, or smoke.
    ### Screen Requirements
    1. Where a site adjoins or is located across an alley from the Residential District, a solid wall or solid fence or compact evergreen hedge six (6) feet in height shall be required on the property line common to such districts, except in a required front yard.
    2. Where a site adjoins or is located across an alley from the Agricultural District, a solid wall or solid fence six (6) feet in height shall be required on the property line common to such districts, except in a required front yard.
    3. Open storage of materials attendant to a permitted use or special permit use shall be permitted only within an area surrounded or screened by a solid wall or solid fence.
    4. Screen requirement must be met with the construction of the building.
    ### Prohibited Uses
    1. All other uses and structures which are not specifically permitted or permissible as special uses shall be prohibited from the C-2 Highway Commercial District.
    ### Height and Areas Regulations The maximum height and minimum area regulations shall be as follows:
    1. General Requirements ```{r C-2 heights, echo = FALSE} c2 <- data.frame( "Category" = c("Minimum lot area", "Minimum lot width", "Required front yard setback (minimum)", "Side yard setback (minimum)", "Street side yard setback (minimum)", "Rear yard setback (minimum)", "Maximum building height", "Minimum street-facing facades utilizing improved surface", "Minimum buffer yard next to residential use", "Minimum buffer yard next to agricultural use", "Minimum depth of landscaping next to street right of way"), "Amount" = c("7,000 square feet", "50'", "25'", "7'", "25'", "20'", "45'", "35%", "20'", "20'", "10'")) knitr::kable(c2, align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c"), longtable = TRUE) %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), position = "left", full_width = F, fixed_thead = T, latex_options = c("striped", "HOLD_position", "repeat_header")) %>% row_spec(row = 0, color = "white", background = "gray") %>% column_spec(1:2, width = "15em") ``` Existing lots of record adjacent to Highway 77 may have a minimum front yard setback of 10'. Existing lots of record adjacent to Highway 77 may have a minimum rear yard setback of 15'. An alley can be used as a buffer yard but cannot be used to satisfy setback requirements.
    ### Community Commercial Operations
    1. Community Commercial operations shall not include uses that are noxious by reason of vibration or noise beyond the confines of the building, or by the emission of particulate, fumes, gas odor, or smoke.
    ### Use Limitations
    1. All operation, activities, and storage shall be conducted entirely inside of a building, or buildings unless; the nearest point of such operation or activity is more than 200 feet from the boundary of any other zoning district other than the C-2 Highway Commercial District or outdoor storage which meets outdoor storage requirements. (Outdoor dining is allowed -- other special events or projects require an approved special use permit).
      2. ### Outdoor Storage
      1. Storage may be maintained outside the building and side yards or rear yards if such storage area is separated from public streets and other property by screening of not less than 6 feet and no more than 20 feet in height. Stored materials must be a minimum of 2 feet less than the height of the screening.
      ### Additional Screening
      1. If a lot in the Commercial district adjoins a residential district, screening shall be provided at the lot lines sufficient to protect, on a year-round basis, the privacy of adjoining residential uses.
      ### Parking Regulations
      1. Parking within the C-2 Highway Commercial District shall be in conformance with the provisions of Article 7 of these regulations.
      ### Corner Lots
      1. Plantings, structures signs, fences, and walls within the C-2 Highway Commercial District on corner lots shall be in conformance with Article 8.8.7 of these regulations.
      ### Site Lighting
      1. Site lighting in the C-2 Highway Commercial District shall be conformance with the provisions of Article 8.9 of these regulations.
      ### Storage and Shipping Container Placement and Use Requirements
      1. It shall be unlawful to place, use, allow, or maintain shipping containers, trailers, or any vehicles within the C-2 Highway Commercial District for storage purposes.
      2. These restrictions shall not apply to, and no permit shall be required for, the placement of portable storage containers in any zoning district for temporary use for not more than fifteen (15) days out of every 365 days. Persons placing portable storage containers upon their premises shall register such placement with the Village Clerk, noting the date upon which the portable storage containers were first placed upon the premises.
      3. Licensed contractors may use shipping containers for the temporary location of an office, equipment and/or materials storage during construction which is taking place on the property where the shipping container is located, if the use is authorized pursuant to zoning permit approval authorizing a remodel or construction project on the same site as the temporarily located shipping container.
      ### Requirement to Subdivide
      1. All developments within the Highway Commercial District are required to the Village of Cortland Subdivision Regulations, regardless of lot size.
      ### C-2 District Diagram ```{r , echo = FALSE} knitr::include_graphics(path = "figures/c2diagramUpdated.png", dpi = 150) ``` ## I Industrial District ::: {.content-hidden when-format="pdf"} ```{r Viz I} #| warning: false #| message: false #| echo: false imap <- cortland %>% filter(zoning == "i") %>% mutate(zoning = "I") %>% rename("Zoning" = "zoning") mapview::mapview( imap, zcol = "Zoning", map.types = c("CartoDB.Positron", "Esri.WorldImagery"), col.regions = c( "#FFAA00" ), alpha.regions = c(0.50), lwd = 1.5, layer.name = "Zoning" ) ``` ::: ### Intent This district is designed to provide for a wide range of industrial and related uses. ### Permitted Principal Uses and Structures The following shall be permitted as uses by right:
      1. Agriculture, excluding the expansion of existing or development of commercial livestock facilities/operations;
      2. Animal care;
      3. Automobile sales and services;
      4. Automotive wash facilities;
      5. Bottling works;
      6. Building material sales, except for ready-mix concrete plants and similar uses which emit particulate, odor or smoke;
      7. Carpenter, cabinet, plumbing or sheet metal shops;
      8. Grain storage;
      9. Construction sales and services;
      10. Dry cleaning and/or laundry plants;
      11. Farm implementation sales and services;
      12. Farm produce sales;
      13. Food service, restaurants and taverns;
      14. Freight and truck terminals;
      15. Frozen food lockers;
      16. Furniture warehouses;
      17. Garden centers and nurseries;
      18. Groceries, retail and wholesale;
      19. Light manufacturing operations, providing that such use is not noxious by reason of vibration or noise beyond the confines of the building, or by the emission of particulates, fumes, gas odor, or smoke;
      20. Machinery sales and storage lots;
      21. Mobile and modular home sales and manufacturing;
      22. Newspaper publishing plants;
      23. Public and quasi-public uses of an educational, recreational or religious type including public and parochial elementary schools and junior high schools, high schools, private non-profit schools, churches, parsonages, and other religious institutions; parks and playgrounds;
      24. Public utility and public service uses;
      25. Transportation warehousing;
      26. Warehouse or storage houses;
      27. Wholesale sales and services; and
      28. Any similar uses that are determined by the Village Board after referral to and recommendation by the Planning Commission to be of an industrial use similar to the above listed uses.
      ### Permitted Accessory Uses Accessory uses and structures normally appurtenant to permitted uses and structures. ### Permitted Special Uses A building or premises may be used for the following purposes in the I Industrial District if a special permit for such use has been obtained in accordance with Article 6 of these regulations.
      1. Junk and salvage yard (in conformance with Article 6.3);
      2. Recycling center; and
      3. Ethanol and/or alcohol plants.
